_comment: Deterministic settings for the plugin safety harness. provider=mock returns built-in demo data with no network, so update() and display() render identically on any host. freeze_time pins the wall clock so the rotation stays on card 0 (the summary card) for a stable golden. sizes covers the narrow/short panels (64x32, 128x32, 256x32), the wide-short rig (192x48), and the two tall panels (128x64, 256x64) to exercise the adaptive font tiers, carrier badges, and marquee/truncation.
